business_problem: Mirakl wanted AI to become a company-wide capability that speeds internal work, improves support, and removes friction from marketplace catalog onboarding so retailers can move toward agent-driven commerce.
solution_summary: Mirakl moved from a goal of "everyone uses AI" to "everyone builds with AI," embedding OpenAI-powered workflows into both internal operations and customer-facing commerce systems. ChatGPT Enterprise accelerates internal technical documentation and serves as a builder surface for teams redesigning workflows. Mirakl also built a support agent grounded in company documentation so customer questions can be answered instantly in multiple languages while humans focus on higher-value work. For marketplace data onboarding, its AI-native Catalog Transformer restructures and categorizes incoming catalog data far faster than manual processes, reducing errors that would otherwise hurt conversion and time-to-revenue. Looking ahead, Mirakl is extending these patterns into Mirakl Nexus, infrastructure for multi-merchant baskets, complex transaction flows, and retailer integrations so agent-native shopping and service experiences can run on top of the company's existing marketplace network.

data_flow: Internal documentation and support knowledge flow into ChatGPT Enterprise and the support agent, which answer questions or draft content for employees and customers. Seller catalog data then passes through Catalog Transformer for onboarding and categorization, while Mirakl Nexus connects retailer systems and transaction flows for future agent-native commerce experiences.
business_outcome: Mirakl sped up internal documentation by 70%, improved support efficiency by 37% while keeping satisfaction at 96%, reduced catalog onboarding time by 91%, and cut categorization errors by about half as it prepared for agent-driven commerce.
